top_signals.title: Ubiquiti patches three max severity security vulnerabilities
top_signals.summary: Ubiquiti has released security patches for three new maximum-severity vulnerabilities that threat actors can exploit remotely without privileges. [...]

top_signals.title: Medical device firm Boston Scientific says cyberattack has disrupted shipment processes
top_signals.summary: The company released a statement and filed documents with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) saying a cybersecurity incident was discovered on Tuesday.
